jobDescription:
Apex Data Systems is hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join our platform engineering team. You will design, build, and maintain scalable backend services that power our data pipeline and customer-facing APIs.

Responsibilities:
- Architect and implement high-throughput REST and gRPC APIs in Python or Go
- Lead technical design reviews and mentor junior engineers
- Improve reliability and observability of distributed systems (SLOs, alerting, tracing)
- Drive database schema design and query optimization across PostgreSQL and Redis
- Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code practices
- Collaborate cross-functionally with product managers and data scientists

Requirements:
- 4+ years of backend software engineering experience
- Deep expertise in Python (Django or FastAPI preferred) or Go
- Strong experience with relational databases and query optimization
- Familiarity with async task queues (Celery, RQ, or similar)
- Understanding of distributed systems concepts (caching, message queues, eventual consistency)
- Experience with Docker and container orchestration (Kubernetes a plus)

Nice to have:
- Experience with AWS or GCP cloud services
- Contributions to technical architecture decisions at team or org level
- Knowledge of data engineering pipelines (Airflow, Spark)
